source_reference: Gemini task-allocation, cost-graph and make-or-buy proposal supplied by the user on 2026-08-21
source_manifest_reference: Complete bounded proposal text in the conversation

items.source_item: Cost of Delay divided by duration as universal priority
items.intent: Invest capacity where delay destroys the most value
items.rationale: Keep monetary Cost of Delay ranges separate from relative WSJF. Scores order only comparable eligible work and cannot override protected obligations, readiness, assurance or authority.
items.protected_outcome: Economically informed capacity allocation without false precision
items.verification_reference: Cost-of-delay and WSJF section plus unit-separation validator
items.follow_up_trigger: A comparable project portfolio enters investment review

items.source_item: Little's Law proves more WIP increases lead time and cost exponentially
items.intent: Reduce excess unfinished work and waiting
items.rationale: Little's Law relates long-run average WIP, throughput and lead time under a defined stable boundary. It does not itself establish exponential costs or predict a heterogeneous single task.
items.verification_reference: Little's Law limitations and flow KPI rules
items.follow_up_trigger: Comparable arrival, throughput, WIP and lead-time observations exist

items.source_item: A euro outside the critical path creates exactly zero release-time benefit
items.rationale: Critical-path evidence is useful, but near-critical variance, resource contention, protected work, risk reduction and option creation can make noncritical work valuable. Recalculate after material changes.
items.protected_outcome: Schedule leverage without starving resilience or future constraints
items.verification_reference: Critical path, PERT and resource-constraints section
items.follow_up_trigger: A project network and constrained-resource calendar are baselined

items.source_item: Unfinished or early code is always dead inventory capital
items.rationale: Unaccepted WIP carries waiting, integration and obsolescence exposure, but bounded prototypes, discovery and option-preserving work may create evidence. Classify purpose and stop condition rather than treating all WIP as waste.
items.protected_outcome: Less premature work while preserving useful learning
items.follow_up_trigger: A task proposes work before its delivery baseline is ready

items.source_item: Build core IP and buy every commodity
items.intent: Reserve scarce experts for differentiated work
items.rationale: Core/commodity classification starts but cannot finish a sourcing decision. Lifecycle TCO, sovereignty, assurance, integration, lock-in, supplier risk, skill retention and exit may reverse the default.
items.verification_reference: Make, buy or hybrid section and multi-alternative TCO contract
items.follow_up_trigger: A material internal-build or external-component choice arises

items.source_item: Open-source or standard tools transfer maintenance cost to vendor or community
items.rationale: Upstream maintenance does not remove Triton's integration, security, compatibility, qualification, operations or migration responsibility. Model full TCO and support/exit evidence.
items.follow_up_trigger: An open-source or vendor component is costed

items.source_item: Two binary questions are sufficient before every work package
items.rationale: Keep the questions as prompts, but material allocation also checks protected obligations, readiness, uncertainty, dependencies, resources, portfolio balance, TCO, authority and invalidation triggers.
items.verification_reference: Seven-step decision order and validated record

items.intent: Use consistent evidence to challenge poor portfolio choices
items.rationale: The runtime validates inputs and calculates an indicative relative proxy only. It cannot commit capacity, buy a tool, alter the backlog, waive controls or approve release; the named humans decide and later compare realised outcomes.
items.protected_outcome: Repeatable decision support with human accountability
items.verification_reference: Validator non-authority boundary and investment-decision accuracy KPI
items.follow_up_trigger: A project pilots the record on comparable tasks
